title: Sorrell Hill Milk Co.
about: Sara and Josh Kerrick met showing cows at the Cayuga County Fair. Sara grew up on a farm selling corn and pumpkins with her parents and studied dairy science at Morrisville. Josh grew up on a small dairy farm in Moravia. Later, Sara milked about fifty goats at a dairy that bottled its own milk on site, and that gave the couple the idea for a creamery of their own.

The Kerricks moved back to Baldwinsville in 2022, made hay and bought show cows. In March 2025 Amy and Barry of 2 Kids Goat Farm offered them space, and Sorrell Hill Milk Co. opened there as an on-farm creamery. It is home to the CregoCrest Registered Holsteins. They describe themselves as a fourth-generation family farm, and every cow and goat in the small herd has a name.

From that milk they bottle pasteurized creamline cow’s milk and goat milk in half gallons and make fresh cheeses, including burrata, mutzadel and 2 Kids Goat Farm chèvre. Their farm store is on East Sorrell Hill Road, about eleven miles from Eden.
